pathRules: Use the exact session UUID returned by Codex.
Do not persist credentials, tokens or unnecessary prompt bodies.
permissions: Do not broaden sandbox or approval policy during resume.

content.queryContract: Canonical Work Unit JSON links the exact Codex session and Git evidence.
redactionRules: Store prompt hashes or bounded summaries only when required.

cases: admission input missing -> refuse before exec
exec exits before terminal -> resume same UUID
wrong or missing UUID -> terminal failure without --last
controller starts twice -> second controller refused
Work Unit requests interview during active execution -> controller continues from recorded decisions or terminal-fails

content.promotionRule: AI review and Human review precede merge.
currentSpecificationGates: No active SQLite, WAL, lease or fencing contract
implementationGates: CLI parser fixture captures session UUID
